mentions.name: OpenMined
mentions.description: A non-profit working to deconcentrate power over AI by building better infrastructure for external auditing and oversight of AI systems, and better infrastructure for local and federated inference and training. The organization is also hiring engineers and product managers.
mentions.problem: Power over AI is concentrated; better infrastructure is needed for external auditing/oversight and for local/federated inference and training.
